// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// School-granularity and billing-attribute aggregation, which is the whole of
// what R10 permits. No having:, no _max, no _min, keys written inline.
import "server-only";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export const MIN_CELL = 10;

export async function subscriptionMix() {
  return db.subscription.groupBy({ by: ["kind", "status"], _count: true });
}

export async function seatsBySchool() {
  return db.teacher.groupBy({ by: ["schoolId", "role"], _count: true });
}
